# Selective Lesson Examples

## 1. Verified authorization failure

An unapproved destructive operation reveals missing authorization enforcement.
Agent supplies critical impact, observed test/task link, verified safe behavior,
coverage check and corrective rule. Capture creates active LL-001 for 180 days,
review due 90. An unsupported speculative fix instead returns
incident_handoff_required; lifecycle owner establishes an owned incident task.

## 2. Skip ordinary events

A harmless one-off typo, local fixed bug without reusable gap, or safeguard
already enforced by an effective test is not a persistent lesson. Return skipped
using retain=false or covered=true after agent evaluation. Repeated harmless
typos do not become high-value simply through occurrence count.

## 3. Deduplicate recurrence

Verified blocking CLI contract has high_value admission, systemic_contract_gap
basis and observed evidence. Same normalized cause/rule merges only with
recurrence=true and distinct new verified occurrence evidence; two references
are retained. A repeated read/evidence link is duplicate and byte-identical.
An applied regression reopens the same retained ID; after purge next_id ensures
a new identity. Cross-skill reuse links applies_to rather than copying records.

## 4. Candidate and application

Select does not modify status. Set planned with real open owned task, existing
candidate and concrete change/test mapping. Failed publication preserves plan
or releases with matching task/reason; TTL never pauses. Published safeguard
plus scoped passing test receipt allows applied. Same receipt replay is
unchanged and does not reset 30-day retention. Candidate-only evidence blocks.

## 5. Expiry and critical handoff

At now == expires_at selection excludes immediately. Prune preview is read-only.
Critical risk stays physically retained until a real open owned task with
scoped lesson backlink is verified. Arbitrary task strings do not qualify.
After retirement and 30 days, purge still blocks without revision-bound explicit
preservation approval. Applied tests, risk tasks and history are never deleted.

## 6. Finite override and legacy

User explicitly retains an otherwise minor preference for 14 days: document
request/purpose/ttl_days, preserve minor severity. No-retention takes precedence.
An undated raw/reviewed/incorporated lesson under the legacy filename is protected
for reviewed migration, not dated today or silently marked applied. Two files
block ambiguity. Routine selection returns at most five relevant summaries and
critical overflow notice; zero relevant lessons is valid.
